_why: ONE corpus of roborev review bodies, parsed by BOTH runtimes that decide whether a FAIL verdict
with nothing in it may stop blocking a merge (beads sparkle-6ca0yg, sparkle-edk2r1).
(the merge_pr pre-check and pr_roborev_status) and `body_carries_no_finding` in
apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/worktree.rs (the roborev_drain_gate sink every in-app merge reaches).
If the two definitions drift, one surface reports a branch clean while the other refuses it.
Both suites assert every case below, so changing one definition reds the other suite too.
`noFinding: true` makes the gate MORE permissive, so every such case must be PROVABLY empty;
the `false` cases are the paired half that keeps a real finding blocking.
